items.fdcDescription: Beans, from dried, NS as to type, no added fat
items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Dried shelled broad beans' to USDA FNDDS 'Beans, from dried, NS as to type, no added fat'. The target explicitly specifies dried shelled beans and its own pinned evidence contains this generic from-dried, no-added-fat record. The generic type-unspecified record is chosen deliberately rather than misclassifying broad/fava beans as white, lima, pinto, black, kidney, or Peruvian beans. Confidence remains medium because FNDDS does not preserve the exact broad-bean cultivar or dry-versus-rehydrated weight basis; this review does not generalize to canned beans or beans cooked with added fat.
